verdict.rationale: The only AI-related evidence is a "Payroll AI" that proactively collects time data, flags inconsistencies, and texts the admin updates. That is outbound, proactive automation, not users operating the product through natural-language commands. Nothing in the pack shows a chat, assistant, or natural-language command interface, and the developer API, SDK, and llms.txt items are building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
